status: Exploratory extension after seeing Option B results; fixed before the new HOG experiment
question: How does a hand-crafted gradient descriptor compare with frozen CNN features on the identical images and split?
feature: 224 square global-view luminance, unsigned 9-bin HOG, 16x16 cells, 2x2-cell blocks, stride one cell, L2 block and image normalization
split_policy: Reuse existing manifest, test identities and groups exactly; no split/seed search
selection: Validation macro F1; smallest C wins ties
classifier: L2-regularized multinomial logistic regression, balanced class weights, lbfgs, max_iter=2000
scaling: Deterministic per-image normalization only. No learned scaling, PCA or feature selection.
calibration: None for HOG. Existing CNN temperatures and review threshold remain unchanged.
uncertainty: 2000 paired visual-group bootstrap draws, seed 17, fixed model and split; no independence claim for 945 images
fusion: No HOG+CNN fusion experiment; keep one focused course comparison
